outcome.description: Whether the nudge reached the target. Callers that reason from a nudged agent's silence must read this before drawing any conclusion: a dropped nudge never arrived, so the silence says nothing about the agent.

state.description: The underlying record behind the outcome: a live queue bucket (pending/in_flight/dead) or the shadow bead's lifecycle state (queued/injected/accepted_for_injection/failed/expired/superseded).

reason.description: Why a nudge was dropped, when the record carries one.
